result.description:
About our Organisation 
VENTORA is the name behind iconic Australian brands including A&L Windows & Doors, Breezway louvres, Corinthian Doors, Stegbar Windows & Doors and Trend Windows & Doors.
As an established manufacturer with over 4,500 employees, our vision is to inspire our customers through leading brands, great service, innovative new products and solutions leveraging the full VENTORA portfolio, while significantly enhancing our ease of doing business built on operational excellence.

About the Opportunity
We are currently seeking an experienced Operational Excellence & COPQ (Cost Of Poor Quality) Transformation Specialist to join our committed team.
Reporting directly to our Chief Transformation Officer and indirectly to our Chief Manufacturing Officer, you will be responsible for driving operational excellence across all VENTORA Group manufacturing sites. Your focus will be accelerating the reduction of COPQ, supporting Transformation projects and preparing sites for scalable growth. This role is key in ensuring the readiness of Red List sites and ensuring that manufacturing processes are optimized to support business growth targets, including a 2x increase in in capacity.
Responsibilities include:
•	Drive COPQ Reduction Across Sites: Lead initiatives to identify, address, and reduce COPQ at each manufacturing site, fast-tracking reduction actions.
•	Support Transformation Projects: Provide operational support for the successful execution of Transformation Projects, aiming to modernize manufacturing processes and systems.
•	Red List Site Support: Work directly with Red List sites to build operational foundations and enhance manufacturing readiness for growth, ensuring these sites meet operational standards.
•	Enhance Manufacturing Efficiency: Identify and implement process improvements that reduce downtime, improve throughput, and optimize resource utilization across sites.
•	Leadership Support: Assist site leaders in improving operational performance, driving COPQ reduction, and supporting data-driven decision-making to foster a culture of continuous improvement. 
•	Operational Systems and Process Standardization: Work closely with local Operational Managers to develop and standardize operational systems, quality control, and inventory management processes across all sites.
•	Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with various departments to ensure alignment and successful execution of operational goals, focusing on operational excellence, cost-saving initiatives, and continuous improvement.

About You
You will bring the following skills and experience:
•	Manufacturing Leadership: Extensive senior operational management experience with a track record of improving plant operations, driving site performance, driving manufacturing excellence and achieving performance targets in a multi-site environment. 
•	COPQ Expertise: Proven track record in reducing COPQ and implementing strategies to improve product quality and profitability across manufacturing sites.
•	Operational Excellence: Deep knowledge of lean manufacturing, process optimization, and cost-saving initiatives to enhance operational performance.
•	Cross-functional Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across functions to drive transformation projects and foster a collaborative, high-performance culture.
•	People Development: Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop operational leaders and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
•	Results-Oriented: A focus on achieving measurable results and driving continuous improvement across all operational areas.
•	Time Management: Effective time management and organizational skills to prioritize tasks, manage workloads, and ensure deadlines are met.
•	Innovation: Ability to think outside the box and implement innovative solutions to improve manufacturing processes and drive operational excellence.
•	Adaptability: Ability to manage change and navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.
•	Driver’s License: Hold a current unrestricted driver’s license to perform the requirements of the role.
•	Educational Qualification: A diploma or degree in a relevant discipline (business, engineering, manufacturing) or equivalent experience is preferred.

About the Benefits
•	Permanent, full time role with established industry leader
•	Annual salary: $150,000 - $180,000 (depending on experience) + super.
•	Flexible work arrangements, with 2 days per week WFH
•	Generous discounts on our extensive range of products
•	Ability to schedule leave every year over the Christmas period.
•	Additional paid day’s leave on your birthday
•	Flare benefits program - salary packaging, discounts and premium perks
•	Employee Assistance Program access
•	Career progression opportunities as part of a 4,500-employee organisation
result.title: Operational Excellence & COPQ Transformation Specialist

result.description: Hayman Industries   Duties and Responsibilities    Review blueprints and drawings, and taking measurements to plan layout and procedures  Prepare for the job from selecting and preparing metal and determining the appropriate welding tools/ equipment/ machineries and method based on requirements  Mark-out reference points for columns or plates, following blueprints and using straightedges squares, transits and measuring instruments.  Align, cut, shape, fabricate and bend metals using the appropriate tools, equipment and machineries.  Join metals and structures using welding, bolting and riveting methods  Weld steel components with welding equipment as specified by layouts, engineering drawings, work orders or verbal instructions. Ensure to examine work for width of bead, penetration and precision.  Ensure the finishing product is clean and smooth by filing, chiselling and grinding. Also, polish, fill and bathe finished welds in acidic solutions.  Maintain a safety focus with a high attention to detail     Relevant Qualification and Experience   At least a relevant Certificate III or IV plus 1 year relevant experience OR 3 years relevant experience in substitute to the qualification    Relevant Skills    Proficiency in multiple welding techniques , 1G,1F,2F and 2G welding position, proficiency in fillet and multi run but welds, and pipe welding.  Physical Stamina and good hand-eye coordination  Understanding of hazardous material handling and knowledge of safety protocols and regulations  Strong communication and problem-solving capabilities  Attention to detain  Team collaboration   About Company    Since the 1950's, Hayman Industries has been at the forefront of steel products manufacturing and fabrication.  From its humble beginnings as a distributor of fence fittings and horseshoes to rural NSW, Hayman Industries has grown to be the leading manufacturer and supplier of engineered steel structures to a whole range of industries including utilities, power stations, roads and traffic authorities and companies involved in construction and infrastructure projects across Australia. Due to our continued expansion, we are seeking skilled Welders and Boilermakers to join our dynamic team.
